mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, leading to increased wage pressures and thus negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE decrease > 0.5pp does not correlate with subsequent wage inflation.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past 6 months signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns do not show a significant positive trend following RSAFS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past 3 months signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decrease > 1% does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the past month signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase > 200,000 does not correlate with subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months signals robust demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase over 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS does not correlate with subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% annualized over the past 3 months, the combination signals tightening monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 1% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) increases by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past 3 months, the combination signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decrease > 1% and UNRATE increase > 0.5pp in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.
